players.bio: Alex Nicolao Telles (Brazilian Portuguese: ; born 15 December 1992) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Botafogo. Telles started his career at Brazilian Série D side Juventude, before being sold to Série A side Grêmio in 2013. That year, he was voted the best left-back in the league.

Allan Marques Loureiro (born 8 January 1991), commonly known as Allan Marques or simply Allan , is a Brazilian footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Botafogo.

Arthur Mendonça Cabral (born 25 April 1998) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Botafogo. In October 2021, Cabral received his first call-up to the Brazilian senior team for 2022 FIFA World Cup qualification matches as an injury replacement for Matheus Cunha.
Arthur Largura Chaves (born 29 January 2001) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for German Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim.
Caio Alves Roque Gomes (born 9 January 2002), known as Caio Roque, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Portuguesa.

Christopher Ramos de la Flor (born 18 January 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Real Oviedo, on loan from Botafogo. Club career Born in Cádiz, Andalusia, Ramos played youth football for Portuarios de Cádiz, Géminis San Miguel CF, AD Raúl Navas, Cádiz CF and AD Tiempo Libre. In 2016, after finishing his formation, he joined Tercera División side CE Mercadal.
Cristhian Joel Loor Santamaría (born 9 March 2006) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Brazilian Série A club Botafogo.

Cristian Nicolás Medina (born 1 June 2002) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Estudiantes. Medina had previously played for Boca Juniors. In 2012, he was chosen for a player trial at the Social and Sports Club El Fortín in Moreno at the age of 10.

Danilo Pereira da Silva (born 7 April 1999) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish Premiership club Rangers. After playing youth football for several clubs in Brazil, Danilo joined Dutch club Ajax in 2017. He scored nine goals in 20 first-team appearances for Ajax, and had a loan spell at Twente.

Danilo dos Santos de Oliveira (born 29 April 2001), known simply as Danilo, Danilo Oliveira or Danilo Santos, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Botafogo and the Brazil national team.
Gabriel Pereira Justino (born 16 April 2006) is a Brazilian footballer who plays as either a centre-back or a defensive midfielder for Botafogo.

Hakim Ziyech (Arabic: حكيم زياش, romanized: Ḥakīm Ziyāš; Berber languages: ⵃⴰⴽⵉⵎ ⵣⵉⵢⵢⴰⵛ, romanized: Ḥakim Ziyyac; born 19 March 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a right winger or an attacking midfielder for Brasileiro Série A club Botafogo. Born in the Netherlands, he represented the Morocco national team.

Carlos Joaquín Correa (Spanish pronunciation: ; born 13 August 1994), nicknamed "El Tucu" (derived from his home province of Tucumán), is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Estudiantes.
Jordan Andrés Barrera Herrera (born 11 April 2006) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Botafogo.

José Antonio dos Santos Júnior (born 11 October 1994), known as Júnior Santos, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Botafogo. Club career Born in Conceição do Jacuípe, Bahia, Júnior Santos never represented any clubs as a youth. Known as Berimbau, after impressing for amateur sides in his hometown, he was invited for a trial period at Osvaldo Cruz.

José Kadir Barría Rose (born 18 July 2007) is a Panamanian footballer who plays as a forward for Brazilian club Botafogo and the Panama national team. Club career Born in Panama City, Barría played for local sides Chievo Academy Panamá, Parma Academy Panamá and Atlético Nacional before impressing the scouts of Botafogo during a tournament in September 2024.
Kaio Fernando da Silva Pantaleão (born 8 September 1995), known mononymously as Kaio, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Brazilian club Botafogo.
Leonardo Matias Baiersdorf Linck (born 3 March 2001), known as Léo Linck, is a Brazilian footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Botafogo.
Lucas Gabriel Monzón Lemos (born 29 September 2001) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a defender for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Botafogo.
Lucas Martín Villalba Jaume (born 11 May 2001) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Botafogo.
Fernando Marçal de Oliveira (born 19 February 1989) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Botafogo.
Mateo Ponte Costa (born 24 May 2003) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Botafogo.
Matheus Martins Silva dos Santos (born 16 July 2003), known as Matheus Martins, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Botafogo.
Nathan Ribeiro Fernandes (born 16 February 2005) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bulgarian First League club Ludogorets Razgrad on loan from Botafogo.
Paulo Victor da Silva (born 3 January 1995), commonly known as Paulinho, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Danish Superliga club Midtjylland.
Raul Jonas Steffens (born 28 July 1997), known as Raul, is a Brazilian footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Botafogo.

players.n: Victor Hugo Custódio de Melo Moura

players.bio: Victor Alexander da Silva (born 23 July 1999), commonly known as Vitinho, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a full-back or wing-back for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Botafogo.
Warleson Steillon Lisboa Oliveira (born 31 August 1996), commonly known as Warleson, is a Brazilian footballer who currently plays for Cercle Brugge.
Ythallo Rykelm Rodrigues de Oliveira (born 22 July 2004) is a Brazilian footballer who plays for Santa Clara.
